observations: Rear view of a Nikon DSLR camera body.
The camera is resting on a gold Nikon retail box.
The box is clearly marked 'D810' in large black text in photo 0.
The camera body has 'Nikon' printed below the LCD screen in photo 0.
The LCD screen is powered off.
The button layout, specifically the inclusion of the 'i' button, is consistent with a Nikon D810.
A watermark 'DALU STORES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is present.
No lens, battery, charger, or other accessories are shown.

risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a recent RAW file uploaded to a shutter count checker.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a very high shutter count near the end of its rated life (200,000+).

risks.proof: A clear photo of the sensor with the mirror locked up, and a sample image of a plain white surface taken at f/22.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a damaged or heavily soiled sensor.

risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, navigating menus, and successfully taking a photo.
A photo showing the included battery, charger, and any cables or straps.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a bare body without battery or charger.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Screenshot of the current shutter count.
Photo of the front of the camera with the body cap removed to see the sensor.
Photo of the bottom of the camera showing the serial number.
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, etc.).
response.reason: The model is clearly identified as a Nikon D810 from the box and body layout. It can be priced at its worst-case functional and cosmetic condition until further proof is provided.
